unit_label: BRBL::MOD_D::U15: Apply registration-related suit disabilities and statutory exceptions

payload.title: Registration affects enforcement without rewriting every transaction
payload.core_explanation_md:
The ordinary partnership framework distinguishes forming the relationship from registration. Section69 imposes specified disabilities on suits enforcing contractual rights by or for a firm or partner where its registration and recorded-partner requirements are not met. Do not convert this into a claim that every unregistered firm contract is automatically void or that no claim of any kind can proceed.

The source preserves the described routes for dissolution, accounts of a dissolved firm and realising its property, as well as the relevant insolvency-official exception. Set-off and other proceedings also require the statutory analysis. Check the cause of action, parties, registration entries, timing and any State amendment before deciding maintainability. Registration after a dispute is not a universal cure for every filing defect.

self_check.prompt_text: What must be identified before invoking the non-registration bar?
self_check.expected_takeaway: The precise claimant, right, proceeding and statutory requirements/exceptions.

payload.stem_md: An unregistered firm wishes to sue on a contractual receivable. Counsel asks for the register entries and filing facts. Why?

options.text_md: Registration determines whether any agreement ever existed
options.explanation_md: That is not the correct general proposition.

options.text_md: The contractual-suit disability has specific registration and recorded-partner requirements
options.explanation_md: Maintainability needs more than a firm name.

options.text_md: All unregistered-firm claims are criminal cases
A bank statement automatically replaces registration
options.explanation_md: It does not establish the statutory entries.

payload.correct_explanation_md: Maintainability needs more than a firm name.

payload.stem_md: A partner seeks dissolution and accounts, and a note says non-registration bars every proceeding without exception. What must be corrected?

options.text_md: Dissolution is never a legal remedy
All firm contracts must be treated as nonexistent
options.explanation_md: The suit disability is not that blanket rule.
Registration affects the specified suit requirements; it does not abolish court jurisdiction over every firm dispute.

options.text_md: The specified dissolution/accounts exceptions must be considered
options.explanation_md: The statutory exceptions matter to this claim.

payload.correct_explanation_md: The statutory exceptions matter to this claim.
